{{Quote|A Je'daii needs darkness and light, shadow and illumination, because without the two there can be no balance. Veer to Bogan, and Ashla feels too constraining, too pure; edge toward Ashla, and Bogan becomes a monstrous myth. A Je'daii without balance between both is no Je'daii at all. He, or she, is simply lost.|Shall Mar, 7,537 TYA|<ref name="DOTJ">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>}}
The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''28,916 before the Battle of Yavin''', also known as '''7,537 after the Tho Yor Arrival''', was a year in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic history]]. That year, [[Je'daii Master]] [[Shall Mar]] was in the process of writing ''[[A Life in Balance]]'', and he philosophized on a [[Je'daii Order|Je'daii's]] need for balance.<ref name="DOTJ" />
